status_values.PASS: Acceptance criteria met for the recorded scope.
status_values.FAIL: An observed result violated the criteria.
status_values.PARTIAL: Evidence covers only part of the criteria.
status_values.UNTESTED: No qualifying acceptance run is recorded.

evidence_levels.LOCAL: Local tests, emulator, build or app.
evidence_levels.CI: Automated CI, contract/build/security checks or deployment verification jobs. Record scope.
evidence_levels.STAGING_API: Direct requests against deployed staging API.
evidence_levels.PROVIDER: External provider participated in the staging journey.
evidence_levels.CROSS_SYSTEM: Complete bounded workflow exercised across surfaces or systems.

metadata.interpretation: Item status describes the stated acceptance scope. Each evidence record has its own result and provenance. Implementation, local tests, CI, rollout smoke and workflow acceptance prove different scopes. The priority applies to overlapping claims about deployed journeys. Preserve separate security and domain test requirements. Higher-quality contradictory evidence overrides lower-quality PASS evidence for the same scope. CI PASS plus hosted browser FAIL leaves the affected criterion failed or partial while the CI record stays intact.
metadata.revision_policy: Record exact tested SHA(s), environment and test time when established. Null denotes unavailable or inapplicable provenance. Use full SHAs, and never infer deployment revisions from a PR merge. Keep historical evidence when invalidated and append the new result with its own provenance.

reuse_policy.default: Reuse scoped PASS evidence and skip unrelated retests. Evaluate the item's retest_if against the change. If provenance is unknown, keep the historical outcome and establish applicability before claiming a current-revision PASS.
exceptions: Relevant implementation, contract or configuration changed.
Later hosted evidence contradicts the PASS.
The item expired or requires periodic verification.
The current task calls for full launch re-certification.

audit_modes.TARGETED_REACCEPTANCE: After a bounded fix, retest affected behavior and directly impacted boundaries.
audit_modes.COMPREHENSIVE_HOSTED_AUDIT: Cover connected hosted journeys at roadmap and integration gates.
audit_modes.FINAL_LAUNCH_CERTIFICATION: Adversarial cross-system re-certification, including deliberate re-exercise of previous PASS evidence.

metadata.update_rule: Use stable item IDs. Append scoped observations with source references and optional details, update item status, and record targeted re-acceptance scope while it is required. Existing finding IDs are informal until a dedicated finding ledger exists.
